blockingIssues.description: WebSocketAuthInterceptor now hard-requires X-User-Id at SockJS/HTTP handshake time, but frontend sends X-User-Id only in STOMP connectHeaders; connectHeaders do not satisfy handshake auth, causing WebSocket connection regression.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit fake-auth WebSocket guidance: if handshake auth is required, frontend/backends must align on HTTP handshake header propagation (SockJS handshake) rather than STOMP CONNECT headers.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Original websocket-backend failure came from permissive handshake fallback; fix-websocket-auth-rejection then regressed connectivity by enforcing handshake headers while frontend still only populated STOMP connectHeaders.
